    after=snap()
    chg=[(k,before.get(k),after.get(k)) for k in sorted(set(before)|set(after)) if before.get(k)!=after.get(k)]
    real=[x for x in chg if x[0] not in (0,1)]
    print(label,"real_chg",real if real else "NONE")
probe(56,34,"c34-35 (right edge center bldg c30-33)")
</parameter>
</function>
